messages.subject: Penrose Robotics - witness prep slipping
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom - separate point from Marldale: on the Penrose Robotics matter, the witness statement exchange is at risk of slipping because the client hasn't signed off Mr Allard's draft. Can you chase the Penrose team this week? Nothing to do with the quarry case - just don't want it falling between us.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
